layers.external: PARTIALLY APPLIED - Kp>2 storm sessions excluded for the 2019 subset (where observation times exist); CYG values are NOT subtracted directly because (1) uniform-V approximation degrades declination (LOO D 0.751->0.858 deg) and (2) logbook F is a per-day single value, so session-time correction is incoherent. For 2022-2025 the survey results record only the year, so no correction is possible. PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTION: results are treated as NOT diurnally corrected (unverified - see ASSUME_NO_DIURNAL_CORRECTION).
